description: This source file implements utility functions for handling HTTP/2 server push in the quiche QUIC protocol library, including extracting promised URLs from headers, validating URLs, and constructing push promise URLs.

methods.name: GetPromisedUrlFromHeaders
methods.description: Extracts the promised URL from HTTP/2 headers, validating method, scheme, authority, and path.

methods.name: GetPromisedHostNameFromHeaders
methods.description: Returns the hostname from the promised URL extracted from headers.

methods.name: PromisedUrlIsValid
methods.description: Checks if the promised URL from headers is valid.

methods.name: GetPushPromiseUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full push promise URL from scheme, authority, and path, validating each component.
